description: Check NexaLayer service status before retrying or filing a ticket. Returns each component (api, sessions, billing, catalog, upstream_network) as operational, degraded_performance, partial_outage, major_outage, or under_maintenance, plus active incidents and recent incident history. If the component your call depends on is not operational, wait and retry later instead of reporting an issue. No API key needed; no charge.
name: nexalayer_check_status
